item.title: Marketing Manager - Defense & Intelligence (NORAM) at Rocket.chat
item.description: Job Title: Marketing Manager - Defense & Intelligence [NORAM] Level: Senior Working Hours: Full-time(40h/Week) Contract: Employee Location: Remote (United States) Your Team 👥 You will report to our Head of Demand Generation and join the Marketing team. On TheOrg, you can view the complete structure of our organisation, including information about every team member, hiring managers, and the size of each department. Who We Are Looking For ✏️ Rocket.Chat is looking for a hands-on, results-driven Marketing Manager to run marketing for the defense and intelligence sector in North America. Experience marketing to defense and intelligence audiences is required, and a military background is a strong plus. This is an individual contributor and full-stack marketing role with a strong focus on channel partner marketing: most of our pipeline in this region is created with and through partners, so you will spend much of your time finding joint opportunities, running co-marketing programs, and helping partners sell Rocket.Chat. You will work side by side with our sales team, understand which accounts and programs they are targeting, and adjust the marketing strategy to match. Alongside partner work, you will run paid digital (LinkedIn Ads, Google Ads, Reddit), social media, content, email and newsletters, and partner-led events, using AI to move faster across all of it.

item.title: Head of AI Native Operations at Supabase
item.description: About Supabase Supabase is the Postgres development platform, built by developers for developers. We provide a complete backend solution including Database, Auth, Storage, Edge Functions, Realtime, and Vector Search. All services are deeply integrated and designed for growth. About the Role We are looking for a Head of AI Native Operations to build the autonomous systems that run Supabase. Supabase is building an AI-native internal operating system, where agents carry the operational load end to end. We are standing up a new central team to build that platform and run it in production. This is the role that leads it, and it is hands-on. You design the architecture, build the first versions of the critical pieces, and are accountable for whether every agent we run is correct, safe, and improving over time. We build rather than buy, and there are no settled best practices for most of this yet, so you will be setting them.

item.title: Software Engineer, Production Engineering at Ramp
item.description: About Ramp Ramp is building the smart infrastructure for finance teams, embedded in the transaction flow of every dollar a business spends. We automate how over $275B in annualized spend flows in and out of 85,000+ companies: authorizing payments, flagging risk, categorizing spend, and closing books. The problems are high-stakes, data-dense, and unforgiving. We hire people with high agency and high urgency. We look for slope over intercept. We care less about where you trained and more about what you’ve built. At Ramp, everyone is a builder who owns problems end to end and makes consequential decisions that shape the outcome.

item.title: Credit Manager (Policy) at Revolut
item.description: About Revolut People deserve more from their money. More visibility, more control, and more freedom. Since 2015, Revolut has been on a mission to deliver just that. Our powerhouse of products — including spending, saving, investing, exchanging, travelling, and more — help our 80+ million customers get more from their money every day. As we continue our lightning-fast growth, 2 things are essential to our success: our people and our culture. In recognition of our outstanding employee experience, we’ve been certified as a Great Place to Work™. So far, we have 13,000+ people working around the world, from our offices and remotely, to help us achieve our mission. And we’re looking for more brilliant people. People who love building great products, redefining success, and turning the complexity of a chaotic world into the simplicity of a beautiful solution.
